sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B — Benchmarks, Specs & Release Date
sources.snippet: Home /mo Home / Qwen /Qwen3.8-27B Qwen3.8-27B Open Weight Qwen3.8-27B is an AI model released by Qwen on Friday, Aug 14 2026, 11 days after Qwen3.8-Max. It is an open-weight model — the trained weights are available to download and run. It is a 27B parameter model with a 262k token context window.
